html:
G'oya

Medianani topish uchun har bir xodimning bo'lim ichidagi tartib raqami (rn) va bo'limdagi xodimlar soni (cnt) kerak. Ikkalasini oyna funksiyalari bitta o'tishda beradi. Keyin o'rtadagi bir yoki ikki qatorni olib, o'rtachasini hisoblash qoladi.

Yechim

WITH r AS (
  SELECT department, salary,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary, id) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS cnt
  FROM employees
)
SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS median
FROM r
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)
GROUP BY department

Hiyla (cnt + 1) / 2 va (cnt + 2) / 2 da: ikkalasi ham butun sonli bo'lish. cnt = 5 da ikkalasi 3 ga teng va bitta o'rtadagi qator olinadi. cnt = 4 da 2 va 3, ya'ni ikki o'rtadagi qator. ROW_NUMBER ga id qo'shilgan: teng maoshlarda ham raqamlar takrorlanmasin.

Tuzoqlar

Tartib raqamini ichki so'rov bilan sanash mumkin: undan kichik maoshlilar soni. Natija to'g'ri, lekin har bir xodim uchun bo'limning hamma xodimlari ikki marta ko'rib chiqiladi. department bo'yicha indeks bu yerda kam yordam beradi: bo'limda 1 200 xodim.

WITH r AS (
  SELECT e.department, e.salary,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees x
          WHERE x.department = e.department
            AND (x.salary < e.salary OR (x.salary = e.salary AND x.id <= e.id))) AS rn,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees y
          WHERE y.department = e.department) AS cnt
  FROM employees e
)
SELECT department, AVG(salary) AS median
FROM r
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2)
GROUP BY department

Oddiy o'rtacha median emas: namunada IT bo'limidagi 30 million maosh o'rtachani 17 milliongacha ko'taradi, median esa 12 million.

Noto'g'riSELECT department, AVG(salary) AS median
FROM employees
GROUP BY department

Takror maoshlarni olib tashlash (SELECT DISTINCT) ham xato: 5, 5, 5, 9 ning medianasi 5, takrorsiz qiymatlar (5 va 9) bo'yicha esa 7 chiqadi.

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da median uchun tayyor funksiya bor:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT department,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY salary) AS median
FROM employees
GROUP BY department

SQLite'da PERCENTILE_CONT yo'q, u yerda yuqoridagi ROW_NUMBER usuli ishlaydi.
